notes.title: Major Update: New 3-Dice Weapon System Added – Gameplay Just Got Deeper! 🧠
notes.notes:
🎲 Huge Gameplay Update: Introducing the 3-Dice Weapon System! 🔥

Hey everyone,

We’re excited to announce a major update to the Ludaro demo — one that elevates the core gameplay with a fresh layer of strategy, planning, and satisfying decision-making.

If you’ve already played Ludaro, you know it’s not just “roll and move.” Even before this update, Ludaro was built around deterministic dice, pre-roll prediction, and post-roll manipulation using Fate and Math cards. But now… we’re turning it up to eleven. 😎
[hr][/hr]🚀 What’s New?
The 3-Dice Weapon System

Every turn, you now roll three dice — and each turn becomes a strategic puzzle:

Choose one die to move your pawn on the board.

Use the other two dice to activate powerful weapons you’ve equipped.

With up to 6 different weapons equipped at once, each offering unique effects like:

Gaining massive points

Boosting your multiplier

Earning coins

Upgrading tiles

Or even getting extra moves

Every die matters — and how you assign each one can change the course of the round (or your entire run).
[hr][/hr]🎮 Why This Changes Everything
This isn’t just a small tweak. This update transforms Ludaro from a light tactical experience into a full-fledged strategy roguelike, where:

Each turn presents a meaningful set of decisions

You constantly balance short-term gains vs long-term positioning

You build synergies between cards, Spirit effects, and now, your arsenal of weapons

Think of it as a fusion of Balatro’s build-crafting, Dicey Dungeons’ dice allocation, and the familiar fun of Ludo — but remixed into something totally new.
[hr][/hr]🧪 The Demo is Live – Try It Now!
🎯 Play the updated demo and experience the new system for yourself:
👉 Play the Ludaro Demo on Steam

💬 Drop your thoughts, feedback, or strategy combos in the Community Hub — we’re building this with you, and your voice genuinely matters.

Let’s build the smartest, wildest, and most satisfying Ludo-inspired roguelike together. 🔥

– Team EvolX Games
